text: {"name":"rf_send_vendor_hci_command","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Queues a vendor HCI PDU for the selected link, initializing additional per-link RF state when the command selector is zero.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"command_selector","v1":"control_block_pointer_slot","v3":"control_block","v4":"command_pdu","v5":"link_index","v7":"link_index","v8":"setup_pdu","v9":"link_context","v16":"per_link_rf_state"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":51,"meaning":"Control-block link index used to select per-link state and included in the command PDU."},{"offset":48,"meaning":"16-bit control-block value copied into the selected link context at offset 236."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"Selected link context pointer to a secondary object whose byte at offset 24 is copied into the command PDU."},{"offset":107,"meaning":"Selected link-context byte copied into the setup PDU."},{"offset":234,"meaning":"Selected link-context field cleared during zero-selector initialization."},{"offset":236,"meaning":"Selected link-context field populated from the control block's 16-bit value at offset 48."},{"offset":35,"meaning":"Per-link RF-state field set to the link index plus 32."},{"offset":37,"meaning":"Per-link RF-state field also set to the link index plus 32."},{"offset":38,"meaning":"Per-link RF-state field initialized to 1."},{"offset":350,"meaning":"Per-link RF-state flags field with bit 0x10 set."}]}
